symbols.name: ja_hysteresis
symbols.summary: Jiles-Atherton hysteresis core with 4x substep interpolation. Implements magnetic hysteresis with smooth transient response using cubic Hermite interpolation between samples.

params.name: Ms
params.description: saturation magnetization, controls maximum output level (100-1000, default 380)

params.name: k
params.description: coercivity, controls hysteresis loop width (50-1000, default 380)

params.name: c
params.description: reversibility factor, ratio of reversible to irreversible magnetization (0-1, default 0.25)

symbols.name: ja_processor
symbols.summary: Complete mono Jiles-Atherton hysteresis processor with drive control, automatic gain compensation, and DC blocking.
symbols.usage: _ : ja_processor(Ms, a, alpha, k, c, drive, trim) : _

params.name: drive
params.description: input drive in linear gain (use ba.db2linear for dB)

params.name: trim
params.description: output trim in linear gain (use ba.db2linear for dB)

io.raw: _ : ja_processor(Ms, a, alpha, k, c, drive, trim) : _

symbols.name: ja_processor_stereo
symbols.summary: Stereo Jiles-Atherton hysteresis processor applying identical processing to both channels.
symbols.usage: _,_ : ja_processor_stereo(Ms, a, alpha, k, c, drive, trim) : _,_

io.raw: _,_ : ja_processor_stereo(Ms, a, alpha, k, c, drive, trim) : _,_

symbols.name: ja_processor_ui
symbols.summary: Mono Jiles-Atherton hysteresis processor with full UI controls for all parameters. Includes smoothed controls and sensible defaults.

symbols.name: ja_processor_stereo_ui
symbols.summary: Stereo Jiles-Atherton hysteresis processor with full UI controls. Applies identical processing to both channels with shared parameters.
